findings.summary: Typography: the translator used U+00A0 inside « » and a plain space before ':'. The fr guide requires U+202F inside « … » and before : ; ! ? in prose, and the sibling keys in this namespace (dictation_failed_transient, secret_fill_*) already use U+202F before ':'. Same defect in not_sent_body, transcription_failed, origin_gone, origin_gone_body (plain space before ':' or U+00A0 in the guillemets).
findings.before: Pas envoyé à « {title} » : {reason}. …  (U+00A0 inside « », plain space before ':')
findings.resolution: fixed by auditor in this change (keys: not_sent, not_sent_body, transcription_failed, origin_gone, origin_gone_body)

findings.summary: 'Pas envoyé' is colloquial negation. The shipped fr refusal copy for the same 'not sent / not done' state uses the 'Non …' status form ('Non envoyée : …' in ui.teamBridge.approvals.result.*, 'Non placé dans le champ secret : …' in ui.chat.composer.secret_fill_*). Subject is the dictated text/message, so masculine 'Non envoyé'. Meaning unchanged: still states a non-send, never a send.
findings.resolution: fixed by auditor in this change

findings.summary: 'un identifiant secret' misreads: singular 'identifiant' is a login name in French, and 'secret' does not turn it into a credential. The core glossary renders credentials as 'identifiants' (55 shipped uses, e.g. credentials_list). Plural, glossary term, no added qualifier; the clause still follows 'Non envoyé : …' as a lower-case clause.
findings.before: les mots ressemblent à un identifiant secret
findings.after: les mots ressemblent à des identifiants
findings.resolution: fixed by auditor in this change
